changes.comment: Add safe authoring for project-local configuration: `config-preview` turns a request of set/unset/suppress/init/set-version edits into an exact byte-level plan, `config-apply` applies a plan as a whole after re-checking every input it observed (each file atomically; a late failure stops later writes and leaves earlier ones in place, reported as partial), and `config-status` reconciles an interrupted operation read-only from its journal. Writes are staged beside the target and published atomically; shared, rig and inherited sources are never edited.
